reviewPolicy: Use official public health agencies, peer-reviewed CDC publications, or agency-linked surveillance summaries. Prefer conservative summaries over scraped granular counts.

sources.title: Reported Cases of Hantavirus Disease
sources.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.use: U.S. historical case context and the state-only geography limitation.
sources.limitations: CDC states public case data are reported by state only and county-level data cannot be provided publicly.

sources.title: Hantavirus Case Definition and Reporting
sources.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.use: Explains national notifiable condition reporting and surveillance definitions.
sources.limitations: Surveillance case definitions are for public health classification and are not clinical diagnostic guidance for individual patients.

sources.title: About Hantavirus
sources.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.use: General description of hantavirus diseases, transmission, reservoirs, symptoms, and risk reduction.
sources.limitations: Broad public overview; local health departments remain the source for local reporting requirements and investigations.

sources.title: Hantavirus Prevention
sources.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.use: General prevention principles for avoiding rodent urine, droppings, saliva, and nesting materials.
sources.limitations: Does not replace local public health, occupational safety, or clinician guidance for high-risk settings.

sources.title: How to Clean Up After Rodents
sources.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.use: Safe cleanup steps for urine, droppings, dead rodents, nests, vehicles, and heavy infestations.
sources.limitations: People with illness after exposure should contact a healthcare provider; heavy infestations may require local health or occupational safety input.

sources.title: Bayou Hantavirus Cardiopulmonary Syndrome, Louisiana, USA, 2022-2023
sources.use: U.S. hantavirus and rodent reservoir relationships.
sources.limitations: Reservoir presence does not mean a specific animal is infected or that human cases are present.

sources.title: Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome
sources.use: New Mexico case summaries, prevention resources, and cumulative historical context.
sources.limitations: State page summaries can update; this project stores the reviewed snapshot date with each derived record.

sources.title: Hantavirus confirmed in Santa Fe County resident
sources.use: Recent New Mexico official case notice.
sources.limitations: Single official release, not a complete live surveillance feed.

sources.title: Hantavirus death confirmed in Santa Fe County woman
sources.use: Recent New Mexico official fatal case notice and prevention reminder.
sources.limitations: Single official release, not a complete live surveillance feed.

sources.title: Hantavirus Infection
sources.use: California prevention guidance, deer mouse context, and links to CDPH map and surveillance PDFs.
sources.limitations: This MVP links to CDPH surveillance products instead of extracting county-level values.

sources.title: Preventing Hantavirus Infection in the Workplace
sources.use: Worker risk contexts such as parks, cabins, campgrounds, and closed spaces with mice.
sources.limitations: Not a case surveillance dataset.

sources.title: Increased Hantavirus Activity in Arizona: Consider Hantavirus in your Differential
sources.use: Arizona official alert summary and 2024 activity snapshot.
sources.limitations: HAN advisories are incident communications and not complete public surveillance datasets.

sources.title: Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome Protocol
sources.use: Arizona reporting, investigation, and source references.
sources.limitations: Written for public health investigation workflows, not for self-diagnosis.

sources.title: Hanta (Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome)
sources.publisher: Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment
sources.use: Colorado prevention, reporting, and state data links.
sources.limitations: The linked data product should be treated as the authoritative Colorado source for updated counts.

sources.title: Notes from the Field: Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome - Denver, Colorado, 2018
sources.use: Colorado context showing that apparent local acquisition can occur outside expected rural settings.
sources.limitations: Single field report; not a general risk map.

sources.title: Hantavirus infection - Annual Epidemiological Report for 2023
sources.publisher: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control
sources.use: EU/EEA annual case context and comparison across participating countries.
sources.limitations: European HFRS-oriented surveillance is not directly comparable to U.S. HPS surveillance.

sources.title: Factsheet on orthohantavirus infections
sources.publisher: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control
sources.use: European reservoir ecology and disease syndrome context.
sources.limitations: Broad factsheet; local national public health agencies remain authoritative for country-specific notices.

sources.title: Hantavirus-associated cluster of illness on a cruise ship: ECDC assessment and recommendations
sources.publisher: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control
sources.use: Official European assessment of a 2026 multi-country cruise-associated cluster.
sources.limitations: Rapid assessments can change as investigations continue.

sources.title: Hantavirus
sources.use: Global disease overview, syndromes, and Andes virus human-to-human transmission caveat.
sources.limitations: Global overview; local agencies provide country-specific surveillance.

sources.title: Hantavirus cluster linked to cruise ship travel, Multi-country
sources.use: Official international notice for the 2026 cruise-associated Andes virus cluster.
sources.limitations: Event-specific notice; not global live surveillance.

sources.title: Epidemiological Alert Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome in Americas Region - 19 December 2025
sources.publisher: Pan American Health Organization / World Health Organization
sources.use: Americas regional alert, Southern Cone context, and surveillance strengthening recommendations.
sources.limitations: Regional aggregate and alert language; country public health agencies remain authoritative for national counts.

sources.title: PAHO supports the international response to hantavirus pulmonary syndrome cases linked to a cruise ship in the Atlantic
sources.use: PAHO coordination context and prevention summary for the cruise-associated event.
sources.limitations: Event-specific update; not a full surveillance dataset.
